description_en: Removes one or more Application Load Balancer (ALB) server groups from a scaling group
description_zh: 从伸缩组移出一个或多个ALB服务器组
kebab_example: aliyun ess detach-alb-server-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --force-detach false --alb-server-group AlbServerGroupId=sgp-ddwb0y0g6y9bjm0000 Port=22 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachAlbServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group, such as ap-southeast-1. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属的地域ID，如cn-hangzhou、cn-shanghai。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove existing ECS instances from the ALB server groups to be detached.

true: removes the instances and returns a ScalingActivityId. You can check the scaling activity ID to determine whether the existing instances are removed.

false: does not remove the instances.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否从待移出ALB服务器组中移出已有的ECS实例。

true：移出，并返回`ScalingActivityId`，您可以通过查看该伸缩活动ID来确定已有实例是否移出成功。

false：不移出。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_detach

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the ALB server group. N specifies the sequence number of the ALB server group
element_fields.help_zh: ALB服务器组的ID。N为ALB服务器组的编号
element_fields.name: alb_server_group_id

element_fields.help_en: The port number used by ECS instances in the ALB server group. N specifies the sequence number of the ALB server group
element_fields.help_zh: ALB服务器组中ECS实例使用的端口号。N为ALB服务器组的编号
element_fields.name: port

parameters.help_en: The list of ALB server groups
parameters.name: alb_server_group
